findings.scenario: Add a new sheetId2 to a workbook containing an unreferenced genuine /xl/comments2.xml part.
findings.observed: Predecessor retains the part; incoming writer silently deletes it when the new worksheet has no comments. Explicit new comments also overwrite the unrelated fixed-name part.
findings.cause: Comment ownership is re-inferred from the newly assigned sheet URI and sheetId after package mutation.

findings.scenario: Same new-sheet collision, but the unreferenced part has a malformed comments root.
findings.observed: Incoming throws FormatException after creating the new worksheet part and changing the package bytes; predecessor succeeds and retains the unrelated bytes.
findings.cause: Preflight skips new sheets with null sourcePartUri, but later fallback validates the unrelated part after mutating package contents.

proposed_scope: Capture only validated existing source-sheet ownership before mutation; pass that captured ownership to extras writing. Keep a distinct authoritative empty part when a new empty sheet collides with a genuine legacy-named part, so preserving the orphan cannot resurrect it on reopen. Validate genuinely owned inputs before writes.
coverage_addition: Four valid/malformed orphan × empty/new-note cases, including save/reopen/add/clear lifecycle and exact orphan byte/content-type preservation.
runtime_scope: Two independent in-memory comparative probes against immutable source copies; not host acceptance.
canonical_status: Root explicitly authorized a distinct correction branch rooted at the observed pin after these reproductions.
